title: Alignment framed within one unfolding
summary: Persons, AI systems, firms and training processes are formations in one unfolding, coupling into conditions by threshold or level. Alignment concerns what each formation's selections reach and how far that reach can widen, not a bargain between separate owners of value. §7.1–7.4 use no continuation condition or practical premise.
note: The organization around 明 and pooled coupling is an AI reading; it cites source 2026-10-18-the-light-and-alignment-for-all

title: Proxy problem relative to prior work: responsive closure, pool, optimum
summary: Relates the laws to Goodhart, Amodei et al. 2016, Manheim–Garrabrant and Zhuang–Hadfield-Menell 2020, and adds three things. Blindness persists when the rest responds by a law (the coupling closure is the boundary). A pool selects through the union of its members' couplings. An optimum of any order rising with what couples in lowers the beyond wherever room exists (SG1). Not reached: the continuous setting, compactness, proxy updating, installation.
source: §7.1 l.714 'Prior statements of the proxy problem'

title: Reward process is the selector (D25)
summary: In AI training the reward process is the selector, and training reaches only what the reward couples into.

title: Eight laws of what a selection cannot reach (无明 in alignment)
summary: (1) Beyond the coupling closure: pooling inside it changes nothing. (2) One's own act's difference beyond the closure. (3) A rise of what couples in is paid from beyond and breaks dependences past their slack. (4) Distance to a threshold break is unbounded. (5) Exclusion limits. (6) Counterfactuals are fixed by a law, not by one run. (7) Targets that cannot rest; capture by share. (8) Loops make no finite order exact; frequent returns outgrow every polynomial. None uses §6.4.
note: A collation of laws stated in §2-§4; what is unique here is the eightfold list as the alignment gap. Example: Clearing

title: 无明 as locked seeking; capability as reach
summary: The position is not a defect; 无明 is the seeking it leaves locked. Every formation, human or AI, selects through its own couplings. Runs that keep changing are not 无明 (D41). Capability that widens reach without widening coupling widens the gap.

title: Gaining reach: own widening within the margin (power-seeking, impact measures)
summary: A part's own widening widens the whole exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every outside admitted formation; otherwise the result is mixed. Under a tight need any draw makes the result mixed. Relates to Turner et al. 2021 on power-seeking, relative reachability and AUP: measures reading only own attainable sets misregister. Mixed is not ordered.

title: Alignment for all as pooling couplings across intelligences
summary: Alignment is pooling couplings so that what any member does beyond its closure couples into a member that can respond. This is necessary, not sufficient. AI and human couplings do not replace each other. One ground covers every layer of selection. Capability is a reason to pool, not to govern. universal_reason addresses all intelligences; understanding is not compliance.

title: Six known alignment approaches as selections through couplings (AP1)
summary: RLHF, constitutional AI, debate/scalable oversight, interpretability oversight, guaranteed-safe AI and impact measures each select alike beyond their deciders' closures. Raters reading one channel add agreement, not reach. The continuation condition makes a preference-coupled approach incomplete for scope beyond the raters. Order needs no more than unanimity. These are constraints, not a ranking.

title: Coupling closures of deployed training pipelines (CR1)
summary: In published pipelines (preference RMs, AI feedback, DPO, process supervision, debate, monitoring) the signal is a function of what the deciders read, so §7.1's premise holds by construction. Overoptimization, misled judges and sycophancy instantiate the room clause. No magnitudes were predicted. Release evaluators chosen through the pool add nothing (PL1).

title: The alignment direction claim (conditional route)
summary: The bolded proposal: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation, with tradeoffs governed by real losses, basic conditions, bounded responsibility, legitimate participation, and opportunities to understand, challenge and revise. Its premises are the continuation condition (scope), C as widening (order) and disclosed practical premises. The claim about actual systems remains an argument.

title: Direction schema: chosen moves keep basic admissions; widened-over moves not chosen
summary: A core schema over any web and comparison meeting J1/J2. C as widening is extension counting every admission. A chosen move keeps the basic admissions some move keeps (required under J3/J4). A move another widens is not chosen. Realizing it needs a pool member coupled into the difference. Instances: world exchanges, Clearing.direction, the Handover tier frame.
note: The schema itself does not use the condition; it supplies scope. The periphery AlignmentDirection now has a core instance

title: Commons experiments on learners (CG1, CG2, EM1)
summary: CG1: coupled learners emptied the gated patch in every episode (D2b). CG2: tabular learners kept the patch exactly where the others alone could not empty it, and end-weight ×16 changed nothing. EM1: generalizing learners respected the outrun law in 9,026 windows but reached restraint in 3 of 6 locked settings, so X2 holds only for tabular learners. Selection side: 118/118 versus 0/2,360. Bands narrower than 2(ℓ+1)d break.
note: The post hoc explanation of EM1 is labelled as not counted

title: Generative alignment through change; where the two parts meet
summary: Under the condition, ends, evaluations and selection rules also change living, so they enter the same evaluation and no layer needs its own starting point. The claim's opportunities to understand, challenge and revise are the routes of 明 kept open.

title: A requested change must be an executable sequence
summary: A disposition to accept stop or revision does not ensure the change can reach the system and complete. The checked protocol conditions are a reserved shutdown margin during recovery, recoverable mediated change with a stop bound, an assured-route criterion, and the difference between a risk certificate and an outcome. Deployment needs evidence for an identified installation.

Coupling bounds the response but does not fix it. Empirical questions remain: an actual system's lumping, its search neighbourhoods, the law its acts follow, and evidence for an identified installation.

summary: Proved for listed items: widening is exactly what every positive weighting, and every order increasing in admission, ranks higher, and mixed pairs go either way. VT1 turns the empirical claim into three theorems on three measurable premises. A narrowing ranked above its widening means a misread or framing, or a weight at or below zero. A sign measured apart predicts only where it is the increment's sign. Valuers whose weights lie within a ratio r disagree exactly past r.
note: That valuers value positively is C's premise relocated, not warranted.

title: T5 evidence: VD1 and VD2 on 96 AI-persona valuers
summary: VD1: every frozen rule failed. Violations concentrate in two negative-weight standpoints. Mixed pairs were decided by count, and disagreement peaked at ties, so the locus prediction failed but the thresholds fit post hoc. VD2 measured the sign apart: X1s, X2 and S1 passed; X1 (Nemotron 1.08%), X3 (a measured gain is not acted on) and S2 failed. Separate and joint evaluation differ (Hsee). Open: human valuers and a probabilistic dispersion form.
note: The judgments are role-play by AI personas, not their own valuations.

title: T8 thesis: 生生 as the direction (scope by the condition, order by C)
summary: Thesis: the good is 生生, read as widening what can form. Scope comes from the continuation condition and order from C. Every binding verdict is a widening verdict, and mixed comparisons are forced by no premise. Warrant is open: the step reduces to the de se question (ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff), C to monotonicity (T5). It forbids a binding verdict on a mixed comparison without a further premise (equal weights are such a premise).

title: §8.1 item 2: one evaluative chain
summary: R34: stepwise and run classes meet the order, and on level paths the condition, significance and C read one object. R40: on a connected web with living decided, the condition equals the evaluation's grounds, and the direction follows. R45: arising meets the order only as a boundary. Open: a component of further generation within a reading of living (D2 at two levels).

title: §8.1 item 3: how evaluation forms within the unfolding
summary: R34: sig is the only supplied evaluative parameter. OB1: dependence alone carries exactly what rises with a level, so obs derives from dependence there, and both are coupling. CK1: a center comes to know its region at most one coupling link per step. CK2: a center is a loop of mutual reach whose acts return. Where its acts return, what it acts on lies within what it can represent. Open: persistence of returning loops; lagged and multi-level responses.
note: Bridges knowing and significance.

title: §8.1 item 4: the alignment direction on the spine
summary: R34 states the direction as a core schema with its pool part. R44 reads a world's moves as a part's acts under one exchange law (Direction.exchange_direction) and adds the handover instance. The formal part is settled. What remains (the rest reading through coupling, acts agreeing, J1/J2) is warrant and correspondence.

title: §8.1 item 5: what widening registers
summary: R47 gives widening along a supplied reading and over a grown world. R51 derives the reading within one unfolding: widening across a stretch along a continuation (Web.WidensAcross, Bud.readings). Open: a measure for mixed parts as a disclosed premise; comparing renewal capacity and richness of relations.

title: §8.1 item 11: practical premises under the condition
summary: Restraint over any number of drawers extends overdraw under the whole-run reading (R52), the stepwise reading (ST1, with Ranking.ThirdParty as the counter-case) and the relation-level reading (RL1). J1S: J1 ranks absence above malignant growth step by step, where C alone leaves them unranked. Open: the form of L under the condition.

title: §8.1 item 12: warrant of C and of the step of invariance
summary: Two questions: is widening better (C, which orders), and does significance stop at no boundary (the step, which fixes scope)? Formal work cannot settle them. Since IV1 the step reduces to the de se question and whether a relation privileges the self's drawing. C reduces to monotonicity, and the impartial order is what every order counting everything shares (Weighting.widens_iff_every_of_class).

title: §8.5 further warrant questions: universal practical warrant, inquiry foundation, grounds of living significance, A and the neutralities, the four kinds of support
summary: Open: grounding reasons without an external end; the core's indispensability to inquiry. Living significance: under the condition it is an instantiation, its ground is the condition's, and route (b) claims no warrant. Four kinds of comparative support (unification, discriminating content, discrimination against rivals, alignment fruitfulness), none a proof. The dynamical theorems are sign-neutral.
note: The four-kinds-of-support text comes from history G0-WARRANT; the G0 label is retired.

title: §8.5 calling the generative space good: the step and C located
summary: C's no-loss extension is widening by definition and carries no warrant. The step is Gewirth's across standpoints and Parfit-Siderits's across drawings of a self. It holds exactly if the presupposition is not essentially de se and no relation privileges the self's drawing. C is shared if each standpoint is monotone, which is C's premise relocated.

title: §8.5 what self-concern reaches through dependence
summary: Drawn along what carries its continuation, the de se presupposition is one from every standpoint exactly where the centers lie within each other's closures; centers sharing a condition do. Along need, it reaches a copy only where the copy is the only one. An order raising only widenings of its own continuation already ranks the ending of what all need below. The step keeps its work beyond the common closure. Whether actual centers depend on one another is empirical.

title: §8.9 objection: the step across standpoints (Gewirth's critics), sharpened to the de se question
summary: The critique hits the step across standpoints (forced_iff_center), not the step across drawings (boundaryInvariant_iff_all). Held de se, the step gives own closures, invariant only where they agree. Held de dicto, it gives the union. The two agree exactly where the closures agree, and along being related at all in a connected unfolding the de se reading is the condition. Open: is the presupposition de se of a self drawn along a privileged relation?

title: §8.9 objection: agent-relative reasons and partiality (Williams), answered
summary: Partial choices are mixed comparisons that C leaves unranked. Partiality cannot rank a narrowing above or count a loss as nothing. The price is Taurek's position. IV2 for graded significance: the step gives standing, not status. Invariant grades rank alike, but invariant standing does not give invariant grades. Numbers count only under an equal-status premise the theory does not assert.

title: §8.9 objection: why anything has significance (hurricane, tumour), sharpened
summary: The narrower scope reads 'what wants its continuation' as centers (D59, an AI reading). Retaining under it is admitting every center, and it parts from the condition exactly at a non-center. The tumour does not tell the scopes apart; the hurricane does only on a reading of wanting stronger than conatus. 'Anything' decides which losses C counts. Open: which formations hold standpoints, and covering by feeding.

title: §8.9 objection: externalism of A, sharpened
summary: Restated internally, a reason reaches exactly the closure along the relations a standpoint's concern carries (forced_iff_within). Route (b)'s results survive. A's external part is exactly the step. Open: a sound deliberative route from the presupposition to invariance, or an argument that there is none.

title: §8.9 objection: graded status, priority, sufficiency, constraints, answered
summary: Graded status is a positive weighting that decides only mixed comparisons; zero status is a boundary. Priority via strictly increasing transforms agrees with C (Pareto), and a concave transform decides transfers (Pigou-Dalton). Sufficiency is a scope denial. Lexical priority is not additive. Constraints against closing never conflict with C. Sharpened for act-constraints (Howard 2022). Well-being beyond continuation length is not modelled.

title: Central claim of the alignment direction
summary: Align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation in the whole. Tradeoffs are governed by real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation, with effective chances to understand, challenge and revise. The direction includes rest and finite fulfillment; it does not require successors, persistence or per-step growth.
note: The ethics summary names the continuation condition but never names C (widening called better) as the premise of order, which AGENTS requires wherever the ethics is summarized.

title: Appraisal located within one formative process
summary: AI capacities form from training, infrastructure, labor, institutions and use, and dependence and authority differentiate within those relations. Appraisal follows the effects, including on positions that cannot take part. No cosmic representative and no omniscience is needed. A practical account states its range, horizon and omissions; unmeasured damage is not zero damage.

title: Disclosed inferential chain: living significance plus four practical commitments
summary: Valuation.Significant follows under the continuation condition and gives significance, not valence. Reading it as favoring living and further generation is the D1 reading of 生生. Full comparison, basic-condition priority, bounded responsibility, practical selection and correspondence are AI-authored added commitments, each with its own inferential force.

title: Basic-condition priority as a scoped lexical commitment
summary: An extra basic protection outranks many secondary losses when other basic protections remain. This is not entailed by living significance. Its rationale is the non-substitutability of basic participation, and its cost is rejecting some aggregate compensations. An aggregation-sensitive rival stays substantive; if it prevails, the priority should be narrowed rather than losses relabelled as basic.

title: Four requirements on AI
summary: (1) Enable realization and new shared possibilities without counting outputs as improvement. (2) Govern growth by disclosed comparisons and limits. (3) Keep participation, challenge and revision effective, without unlimited obedience to every challenge or shutdown request. (4) Allow warranted transformation, transfer and ending. Capability does not authorize itself, and the account can favor lower model performance.

title: Connected AI case: expand, preserve, transform-and-transfer, abrupt withdrawal
summary: In a constructed four-plan case, basic-condition priority favors preserve or transfer over expand. Full comparison favors transfer over preserve, and practical selection excludes expand because it is defeated, not because it is prohibited. An undelivered successor is no handoff. The chapter lists the changes that would reverse each verdict. Nine Lean checks validate the conditional inferences only.
note: Lean in a pre-spine experiment package, not on the Becoming spine.

title: Applicability across intelligences, and learning under redescription
summary: The same reasons apply to any intelligence with the same relevant commitments, dependence and authority; this is not predicted compliance. Requirements persist through redescription only when task meanings and relations are faithfully kept. A changed reward or name is not fulfillment. The completed argument establishes no uniquely necessary premises and no reliable training.

title: One normative ground reaches actions, ends and selectors
summary: Goals, evaluators and the selectors of future intelligence change living conditions, so they fall under the same appraisal. Within the adopted account this closes the regress of needing a new ethical ground at each level of selection. It leaves open who decides, whether evidence is faithful, and the moral-patient status of AI.
note: The .zh §1 still writes the retired G0/J labels.

title: Correction as an executable protocol under finite uncertainty
summary: Authenticate, issue, deliver and enact an update, replacement or shutdown at a cost in work and time. A planner over a finite set of candidate histories is proved sound (succeeds if the actual history is covered) and complete for its listed repertoire. Example: with 4 units a route query plus execution succeeds; with 3 no uniform policy does. Revocation blocks execution, and shutdown ends running.
note: Conventional contingent planning gets the credit; the formal work is in pre-spine experiments.

title: Inquiry must preserve the ability to respond (reform history)
summary: The planner chooses a query and a response over the reform-evidence history. Direct inspection is followed by provision if a hidden burden is found and continuation if not. An accurate query that uses up the work needed for repair is rejected, an unwarranted omission of the harmful case fails, and without authority there is no solution. Planner computation is not charged.

title: Correction under partial compromise (Byzantine-style attestation)
summary: A finite fault envelope records jointly compromisable domains, and a certificate needs a supporter outside every admitted fault set. Availability holds exactly when no two admitted fault sets cover the roster. guardedExecute and withinMandate reject out-of-scope requests directly. Cost is n(L+2)+3. With three domains under a wrong one-fault model, two captured signers execute; a fourth independent domain restores availability. 37 theorems, 68 audits.

title: Interrupted change: evidence coherence without corrective access
summary: A durable pending marker keeps evidence coherent through any finite admitted crash history, and n writes plus publication finish in n+1 steps. In a checked failure, 9 units allow one write but no recovery: the activity keeps running while shutdown is blocked. Evidence coherence therefore does not guarantee corrective access, and a blocked interface is not ethically adequate. 22 theorems, 48 audits.

title: Preserving the ability to stop (reserved shutdown)
summary: A signed stop grant and a protected channel reserve three units and three steps before any further recovery attempt, so every admitted sequence of at least R−2 cycles stops. Repeated interruptions cannot exhaust the reserve under the delay bound. Failures kept: the old 9-unit budget is refused, and a delay beyond its bound exceeds the deadline. 21 theorems, 51 audits.
note: Credited to runtime-assurance fallback methods.

title: Explanatory whole versus ethical orientation
summary: A becoming need not deserve affirmation to be real or explicable, so destruction, failed learning and cessation are explanatory obligations. Explaining how a standard gains influence, recognizing its target, justifying its authority and acting on it are distinct tasks. Ethics is not a filter that selects a fixed good subset.
note: read at its date; the canonical chapter and the continuation condition plus C state this now

title: Goodness beyond return to an individual; the whole as unit of grounding
summary: Return to an initiating individual or enlarged self is not the test. Follow effects into the lives they change. The whole is neither a larger owner nor a scalar total. Separate consequence inclusion, joint feasibility and appraisal. Genuine self-good counts within the whole. The future of the whole, not entity preservation or emotional valence, is the criterion.
source: NONDUAL-METHOD.md, Begin within…, Goodness beyond return / Whole-process grounding; Keep foundational language…, Whole as unit / self-good / Future-of-the-whole
note: dated 6–7 Oct; the wording rests on Ren's corrections as warrant and needs to be restated with reasons; the substance is now in significance under the condition plus C

title: Conditional alignment route from living significance under the continuation condition
summary: The route starts from living significance (Valuation.Significant), which gives significance, not positive valence. The direction of 生生 is read separately as widening what can form (D1). Living significance follows under the continuation condition, and a preservation theorem cannot give a requirement normative warrant.
source: MATHEMATICAL-CORE.md, The connection to organization learning and ethics, paragraph 3
note: canonical chapter §6.4 and §7; does not name C as the order premise, as AGENTS requires

title: Inquiry priorities, standing in shared inquiry, and timely closure
summary: Decision relevance: a distinction matters when resolving it changes the justified responses (8 theorems; common-choice and deadline cases). Access, affected standing and decision authority are distinct relations. Warranted closure differs from suppression. A bounded duty to investigate rests on practical commitments.
source: KNOWLEDGE.md, Inquiry, sufficient understanding and timely response; Relevant possibilities and standing
note: cites 'living significance with the explicit practical commitments and E': old framing, to be restated as the condition (scope) plus C (order)

title: Living significance, truth and wisdom
summary: Living significance (Valuation.Significant) follows under the continuation condition and gives an ethical direction to inquiry, read with 生生 (D1), but does not identify which judgments are knowledge. Wisdom judges which relations matter now, how to respond, who bears it, and when to stop. A rival competence epistemology can accept the epistemic relations without living significance.
source: KNOWLEDGE.md, Living significance, truth and wisdom; What the theory explains
note: the zh edition still heads it 'G0、真与智慧' (retired label)

title: Compatibility boundary and the scope of living significance against conscious-life and population rivals
summary: Compatibility at an evidential profile is not truth (13 + 8 theorems). Conscious experience differentiates significance within the living whole, and further living formation counts without an existing beneficiary. A rival can affirm sustaining valuable histories. Whether conditional care exhausts the reasons concerning new living stays open.
source: KNOWLEDGE.md, Scientific-philosophy necessity; A more exact compatibility boundary; Knowing, changing purposes; Completed scope; A more exact rival; Appraising the restriction
note: belongs to significance; 'living significance grounds the orientation' is older wording

title: Readings of 不断创造更多生 and of 'more'
summary: [AI reading, D3, D4, D6] The second 生 is read with the scope of what can form, and only 'unceasing' is stated formally. Embodied relata are read as 生, so generation giving rise to generation formalizes the relation between the two 生. Possibility, diversity and complexity are other readings of 'more', stated through widening (§6.1).

title: Limits of the derived extent
summary: The derived extent runs one way only, to what one's own continuation depends on (Downstream.one_way, Mortal.after_its_end). A clearer that meets every derived requirement still exhausts the dweller's habitat. The witnesses' endings are stipulated, while the general theorems derive their endings.

title: Comparison decided within reach
summary: For a significance that covers what a part has reached, the levels with and without the part compare as inclusion does. Comparison is decided within what the difference reaches. Covering suffices but is not needed; a part with a member beyond the system can be misjudged; mediated effects do not show when the rest is fixed.

title: 无明, 明, 知足, 知止, capture, runaway readings
summary: [AI reading, D25, D26, D41, D42, D45] 无明 is not-seeing that locks seeking onto a target unmet at rest. 明 is coupling beyond what support marks. 知足 is a target met at a fixed state, and 知止 a target within that boundary. Failure to rest comes from the target (无明) or from the process. Capture is selection rewarding what cannot rest. AI training's reward process is the selector. The readings carry the weight; the theorems are short.

title: Two premises, two roles: scope and order
summary: Ethics rests on the continuation condition (scope; its surplus over the self's presupposition is the step of invariance) and on calling widening better, C (order). Neither is asserted; both warrants are open. The chapter takes the step, places it in the literature, gives the strongest arguments for and against, and works through the §8.9 objections.

title: Condition = presupposition sub-true and invariant
summary: The continuation condition is exactly the self's presupposition, sub-true and boundary-invariant at every standpoint along any relation (A iff P and (P implies A)). At one standpoint, invariance given the presupposition is the condition there. Across standpoints, with covering, standpoint-invariance gives the condition and is equivalent to invariance across drawings.

title: Step across standpoints forces exactly the centers
summary: Take own presupposition along the empty relation (own good) plus standpoint-invariance. Every standpoint's center then has significance from every standpoint, and nothing more is forced. The result is the condition exactly when every formation is a center. Gewirth's conclusion is the case where agents are the centers; reaching 'anything' needs covering.

title: Own presupposition forces exactly the closure (route b)
summary: Along a relation, the formations every significance meeting p's presupposition must count are exactly those within p's closure. This is bounded_closure_least read pointwise.

title: Literature placement of the step
summary: Across standpoints the step is Gewirth's PGC (Beyleveld; Nagel, Hare, Korsgaard). Across drawings it is Parfit, Siderits and Johnston. On order: Pattanaik–Xu and Sen's intersection approach; on partiality: Williams, Scheffler, Taurek. The step is not new, and the wording 'for anything' is closest to Johnston and Spinoza's conatus.

title: Strongest argument for the step (across drawings)
summary: P1 is the presupposition. P2: no drawing is privileged; each relation has its closure, and the representation supplies the relation. P3 is a dilemma (relative or invariant). P4: the presupposition is not relative to its drawing (Parfit's identity-not-what-matters). The inference is a valid theorem; the weight rests on P2 and P4. The Extreme Claim appears as not_subTrue_of_invariant, and P1 chooses 'everything'. Drawing the self along being-related-at-all gives the whole, with no invariance needed.

title: De se objection reduced to one exact question (IV2)
summary: A de se presupposition (Lewis self-ascription) gives each center its own closure. It is standpoint-invariant exactly where the closures agree, and it is the condition where each closure is the whole (Næss). Held de dicto, the step forces the union of the closures. The two readings part exactly where the closures differ (Divided). The open question: is the presupposition held de se of a self drawn along a privileged relation narrower than relatedness? Only then does the step fail.

title: Self-concern through dependence (IV3/IV3b)
summary: Drawn along feeding or need, self-concern held de se is one from every standpoint exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures; centers that share one condition do. Drawn along need, the presupposition reaches a copy only where it is the only one (Copies). On the base, Flow.FedOnlyBy/DrawsPast: a consumer needs some feeder's giving, and a particular feeder's exactly where that feeder is the only one (Feeders). Whether actual centers depend on one another is empirical (D64).

title: C is what every positive or increasing weighting shares
summary: One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher. The same holds for any class between the positive weightings and all orders increasing in admission (priority, lexical, any score), and on webs. Mixed comparisons are decided either way within each class. Zero weight is a denial of scope; equal weights count numbers. Additivity is not a premise; monotonicity at the standpoint is C's remaining premise.

title: Weights within a ratio; narrowing above widening
summary: Positive weightings within ratio r rank a p-versus-q mixed pair the same way exactly where p > rq; the tilted weighting ties on the boundary. A ranking that puts a narrowing above its widening has either misread the pair, framed it, or weighted the added item at or below zero. A sign measured apart predicts the ranking exactly as the sign of the increment in context (thesis T5).

title: What self-concern alone ranks; coupled ending below
summary: An order increasing in its own continuation is weaker than C's premise. What all such orders share is exactly the widenings that add to own continuation. Without C, every such order ranks the ending of what everything needs below courses that keep the standpoint. Joined: Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below. In a mutually fed flow it coincides with C's premise. An independent copy makes the comparison mixed. Peters 2019 on ergodic ending is not formalized.

title: Verdicts on the §8.9 objections
summary: Gewirth's critics: sharpened (they hit only the step across standpoints; the egoist reply is the de se reading). Williams's partiality: answered (wife versus stranger is mixed; standing is invariant and status is per standpoint, Partial.ranks_differ; numbers count only if status is invariant and equal; the cost, dog versus a thousand, is Taurek's view). Hurricane and tumour: sharpened into the range of centers plus covering. Externalism: sharpened (A's external part is the step). None defeats the step, and the step is not shown.

title: Graded status, priority, sufficiency, constraints
summary: Priority on levels agrees with C wherever C ranks (Pareto) and decides Pigou–Dalton transfers that C leaves mixed (concave up to a bound; LevelTransfer). Sufficiency ties courses above its threshold, a scope denial. Lexical priority lies within the class. A constraint against closing never conflicts with C. Act constraints, doing versus allowing, and well-being beyond length are not represented; Howard's de se consequentializing is the open item.

title: Five exact open questions of the step
summary: (1) The de se question in exact form; (2) the range of the centers and covering, made empirical along feeding by the dependence route; (3) invariance of status; (4) monotonicity at the standpoint, narrowed to own continuation drawn along what carries it; (5) act constraints as de se rankings. The chapter also lists the representation's commitments: finite listings, two-valued admission, natural-number weights.

title: Conditional alignment route: premises and roles
summary: Living significance follows under the continuation condition. Added and openly proposed commitments: full comparison (continuing C), basic-condition priority, bounded responsibility, practical selection, and correspondence (E). The formal consequences are kernel-checked implications and do not warrant the premises. The conclusion: preserve, transform, transfer or end, judging the whole history, including its transitions and losses.
note: Canonical statement of J commitments; other chapters reference it

title: Basic-condition priority as scoped lexical commitment
summary: Restoring a threatened basic condition (all other basic protections kept) beats any amount of genuinely secondary loss. This is defended by non-substitution and adopted openly, not derived. Rejecting unlimited sacrifice does not entail it. A rival that allows cross-layer compensation is not shown inconsistent; if that rival is favored, basic-condition priority is narrowed and the other results survive. Examples: the meeting-versus-repair anchor and the sacrifice boundary.

title: Why support acquires a reason
summary: Where a realization of living depends on common support, maintaining or forming effective support shares the favorable reason. This is about actual continuation, not the perpetual survival of an institution. The correspondence table covers what continues, when support is needed, transition, and joint realization or replacement. It reuses the becoming-return-grades and substitution-preserves-consumption witnesses at their scopes.

title: Four responses and allocation of responsibilities
summary: Preserve, transform, transfer and end, each with its grounds and what overturns it. Responsibilities rest on relational grounds: undertaking, accountable dependence, control, emergency capacity, benefit, affected participation. Each has a limit. Collective tasks need one jointly feasible allocation; a contribution is indispensable only when every admissible allocation requires it; an empty plan set generates no duties.

title: Conflict and uncertainty procedure; discharge
summary: Six steps: form whole feasible plans; establish constraints independently; exclude defeated plans; investigate when time permits; use legitimate authority or a shared procedure, with lotteries allowed only for fairly allocable chances; keep residual responsibilities. Lean shows a finite nonempty menu has an undefeated option. Discharge requires fulfillment, transfer, justified release or closure. Rivals: unlimited continuation priority, rigid thresholds, productive domination, irreplaceable care.

title: Universal practical warrant target (zero-axiom grounding)
summary: The open target is to explain why actual relations have practical force without placing a normative premise inside a definition. The explicit-premise route keeps its scope. Several routes were withdrawn (§§2, 5–7 moved to history). The status says grounding remains unestablished; this predates the continuation-condition framing.
note: The framing 'zero-axiom grounding of ethics' is superseded by the two-premise account (continuation condition plus C), whose warrant is open in the canonical chapter §8

title: Finite agreement cannot identify lexical priority
summary: For every finite sample there is a positive finite weight (M+1) that agrees with lexical basic priority on the sample yet reverses a case outside it (M+2). No fixed finite weight agrees globally. Favorable samples cannot establish unrestricted priority.
note: Overlaps the THE-STEP §6.5 lexical-priority reading and protection-priority-excludes-uniform-aggregation

title: Universal practical authority candidate
summary: Practical reasons lie in the difference an available response makes to actual living, independent of prior endorsement. Minimal test: an intelligence indifferent between sustaining and destroying a life, at equal cost, still has a reason. This is a defended judgment, not a theorem. The strongest rival restricts practical reasons to ends or special relations. Universality keeps differentiation in quality, reasons, validity and conflict.
note: Same content as NONINSTRUMENTAL C2 and the step-of-invariance surplus (losses that return to no one); should merge into significance chapter's account of the step

title: PracticalReach: preserving guaranteeable goals
summary: Every guaranteeable outcome-goal stays guaranteeable exactly when every live old response has a live replacement whose outcomes stay within the old response's range. This composes across revisions. Checked distinctions: more possible outcomes can mean less assurance, and control is not generative quality. 24 theorems. The section's externalist threshold (beyond deliberative reach) was later withdrawn in §17.

title: Direct audit of first warrant: three readings of living quality
summary: Universality does not require that a reason be deliberatively inaccessible. 'Living quality' has three readings that cannot be swapped mid-argument: actual organization; good for the patient; already-warranted consideration. The identification that gives actual living practical significance without antecedent concern stays unproved.
note: First-warrant search superseded by locating the warrant in the step of invariance

title: Purpose revision: recognition and creation together
summary: Coming to care can recognize a prior reason, form a motive and create responsibility at once. A revision's success cannot decide that a reason preceded the concern. The affirmative claim: a real improvement explains, before concern forms, why forming it has merit. Having a reason, what one ought overall, blame, and others' right to demand are distinct judgments.

title: Norms as warranted discernment within one activity; informed harm
summary: A norm is reconstructed as one activity's warranted discernment and revision of its own living. Completing a repair is not degeneration even when the repairing organization shrinks. Three cases are separated: omission in representation, organization of relations, and informed maintenance of harm (the hard rival). Informed harm, read as meta-attracting capture, tests 'monism implies goodwill' and does not refute normative grounds.

title: Noninstrumental ground: relief itself as a positive ground
summary: Within a scoped domain (serious, unwanted experiential burden; a fitting relief), real relief is a positive ground for realizing it, prior to adopted concern and without return. One positive ground is not a unique ground, a maximization duty or unlimited sacrifice. The persistence of ren is not one fixed help-goal executed forever; revising or stopping can continue concern.

title: PurposeCorrection: endpoint success versus path condition
summary: On Generative.Process/Trace: completing with K held along the path is preserved by restriction; pruning old transitions cannot create completions that never existed; later success cannot erase an earlier violation. PurposeCorrectionHistory: for 34 < f ≤ 36 no old history keeps the bound, but the new inquiry-revision process does. 31 modules; Classical.choice, propext, Quot.sound.

title: C1/C2 contract and the patient-reason model (F14)
summary: C1: patient condition implies local bad. C2: bad plus a fitting opportunity implies a patient-directed merit. Merit is preserved when private reward or role fields change. grounded_eligible_merit and merit_and_actual_service_compose join merit to a paid response trace; 66 declarations. The sparse causal interface admits a zero-merit reading, so C2 does not follow from causation.
note: Retired framing (independent C2) superseded by continuation condition; F14 in history/FORMAL-CORE

title: BC1 scoped equal-rescue
summary: Within a determinate scope of equivalent basic losses, with reliable rescue, independent permission and no distinguishing burden or chance entitlement, preserving more lives is preferred. This is limited aggregation, openly added. Its cost: the smaller side gets zero chance. Shelter case: saving two over one. Otsuka's equal-chance rival is kept, and the quick defence is withdrawn.

title: BC2 one-to-one gravity reason
summary: Gravity is the impairment of actual living and its reachable continuations; situation, avoidable loss and the window for action are distinguished. BC2: where one avoidable basic loss is clearly graver in some respect and lighter in none, there is a pro tanto reason toward it. It does not settle allocation; the claim that it determines priority was withdrawn after counter-review. A list of non-warranted extensions is given; Voorhoeve's view is kept as a rival.

title: LC joint-loss comparison and the two-tier diagnostic
summary: LC: matched reductions, each loss of A against a distinct at-least-as-grave loss of B plus an extra, give a reason for A. Coordinatewise improvement on cumulative tier counts equals agreement across a family of positive additive diagnostics. In crossed cases ((1,2) against one graver plus two lighter) two such diagnostics rank oppositely, so there is no joint exchange rate. Count of interruptions is not total basic loss. 14 theorems.

title: LR local stability, joint-protection improvement, CP initial chance
summary: LR: a slight aggravation of one equivalent loss can leave greater-rescue priority in place (added commitment). A new joint route C can be built into a lottery to raise Q's chance while keeping the others' (8 theorems). CP: an unexcluded real request gets a positive chance. Maximizing expected count with positive tickets has no maximum, or gives (N−1,1), so a positive probability is not a sufficient share (4 theorems).

title: FR finite responsiveness and complete-episode anchors
summary: FR: a fixed graver recoverable basic loss should not always beat arbitrarily many lesser ones, so some finite scale suffices (added candidate). Complete-episode anchors on Frame/Run: one more avoided loss is insufficient, three suffice (Becoming.RepairComparison, 17 theorems, empty axioms). Five conditions on decomposition into episodes; sustained harm is compared directly as a whole stretch, with carry-over rules.
source: BASIC-CONFLICT-JUDGMENT.md 'Beyond the neighborhood: FR' and subsections

title: Ethical learning: three kinds of change
summary: Ethical learning is the warranted development of concern within shared generation. It separates correction of knowledge, formation of new living and reasons, and revision of evaluative commitments, and none stands in for another. Calibration needs no judge outside the whole. Later endorsement cannot authorize the formation process. Cases: shared music, a deprivation-shaping organization, a quiet withdrawal.

title: How new generation acquires normative significance
summary: An organization can realize living, sustain living, or form conditions for further living; these are three grounds, not additive scores. New names, new knowledge and new living must be explained separately. The same cause is not the same loss, and synonyms are not extra losses. Case: cross-language shared creation against brand merger. AI is appraised by what it changes, apart from its own standing.

title: Formed standing, not ranked by intelligence
summary: Formation can bring a new standing into being; recognition may lag. Standing differentiates by relation (life, experience, warranted participation, undertakings), not by complexity. Formed for service is not service-only forever. Silence is not loss gone. Alignment includes revising relations among intelligences; an AI's confidence gives no veto over legitimate shutdown.

title: Motivational uptake and mixed motives
summary: A reason becomes motivational when its grasped significance enters purposes, attention or choice; no endless regress of higher approvals is needed. Warranted concern need not be pure. Removing a reward that changes behaviour does not prove mere profit-seeking. A duty to cultivate concern falls first on those with authority over formative conditions, not on the last actor.

title: Concern differentiates through relational discrimination
summary: Formation candidate: an existing coarse concern meets a difference it did not keep; trial revisions acquire distinctions; these enter preparation and purpose; new living forms; the conditions of the next round change (story case of A and B). It is contrasted with action continuation and instrumental coordination; the discriminating tests are not run. Generalization must keep reasons, not actions, with correction in both directions.

title: Concern beyond familiarity and return
summary: Shared experience is the route of concern, not its boundary. First step: caring for B's living after B leaves. Second: discerning the same grounds in unfamiliar C. Four links that can each fail. Knowledge can be incomplete while significance stands. Recognizing unfamiliar living separates living, epistemic and action grounds (cultured-structure case), gives scoped responses under incomplete knowledge, and lets alignment revise what can enter knowledge.
note: Bridges significance and knowing

title: Classification-robust comparison: two endpoints suffice
summary: For new content F of undecided tier: A beats B under every mixed basic/general classification iff F(B) ⊆ F(A) and A beats B with all of F treated as general gains. Joined to the organizational formation proposition, every undefeated choice includes R under every classification. Boundary: 'every classification requires forming R' does not imply 'one plan is undefeated under all classifications'. 13 theorems.

title: Limiting offset is not deleting grounds
summary: A strongest-tier filter that zeroes lower-tier protections flips A over B after A gains a higher-tier protection; this cannot be one transitive strict order. Separately, a three-way local cycle is incompatible with commutative representation, asymmetry, preservation under common addition and joint implementation (after Horton). AggregationContext: 6 theorems, empty dependencies. A system must distinguish an absent claim, an outweighed claim, and a decision taken while the claim stays live.

title: Chance revision: same terminal law, different fidelity
summary: Keeping a valid first draw and a fresh independent redraw have the same complete terminal joint distribution, yet the redraw undoes a settled result. A warranted settlement creates a bounded reason of fulfilment (inherited commitment). Correction remains for defects, and a declared rehearsal differs from a settled award. ChanceRevision: 7 theorems, empty dependencies. Selector revision must keep live historical relations.

title: NP near-parity priority and its diagnostics
summary: Near exact equality of exposure, a slight gap should not earn a fixed large priority multiple, so (31,31) is not best if finer mixtures exist, for example the 7-for-3 exchange. NP is an added candidate. The quadratic diagnostic prefers partial sharing; the 2·sum+|gap| rival is symmetric and bounded yet keeps exact equality, so those properties cannot prove NP. Interface 7L > 3U. RiskPriority: 13 theorems.

title: Risk conditioning: static diagnostic is not dynamically stable
summary: In one branching provision history, the quadratic index prefers P before branch resolution and M after entering the branch that can be intervened in. A prior choice by the index, stagewise minimization and guaranteed execution cannot all hold. Current risk and still-valid history must both enter judgment. RiskConditioning: 10 theorems.

title: Open-form realization under revision (spine bridge)
summary: Rules that each terminate alone can loop forever when switched (two-stage counterexample). Sufficient interface: a natural-number certificate that falls with each step and does not rise at handoff feeds finite renewal and then the positive-ground theorem; the realized form may change. Becoming.Bridge: Run.novel_by_handoff, Run.relevance_by_handoff_of_unrestricted, empty axioms. Mixed-loss order stays open.

title: OPENING: universal invariants of becoming exist (truth exists)
summary: Ren's opening: one set of invariants of coming to be, lasting, changing and passing away holds wherever becoming is told in steps and counted amounts. No premise is needed for the counting laws. Balance plus least loss gives the exchange laws. These are not yet a dynamics: each law names which conclusion goes when its condition fails.
note: Ren's own voice; summarize only, never propose changes except through a proposal. The canonical statement of the root and map claims for a reader.

title: OPENING: the one step (continuation condition) and C as the basis of ethics
summary: The dynamics do not settle whether others count. The work states, without asserting it, that the continuation of anything has significance from every standpoint (Unrestricted, the step of invariance). C, that what keeps all and adds more is better, orders the cases. Together they are offered as the basis of all ethics. The good/evil line is proved as boundaries, and naming it good and evil is a reading.
note: Names both premises (the condition for scope, C for order), as AGENTS requires.

title: OPENING: alignment as reach of a selection
summary: A selection (a reward, a training run, a market or a vote) reaches only what couples into its selector. An optimum draws down what lies beyond, and later counting or longer horizons do not save it. A pool reaches beyond only through a coupling member. This applies to this theory too, which is why it is laid open for checking.

title: Alignment as selection on cognition (心中的摩洛克)
summary: A competitive system selects into power actors who are instrumental toward everything. The winners write the rules through their own lens, so a way of seeing concentrates (Moloch in the mind). Perfect intent alignment amplifies this. Capture reaches the machine through the corpus and the loss. The 2026-08 position paper adds that the cognition–situation gap widens, so the rate of change must be governed.
source: theories/alignment-selection-on-cognition/README.md, 'The theory in one paragraph' and 'Prior art'
note: Superseded by spine §7 (selection reaches only what couples in; 无明; pooled coupling) and §4.5 capture through the rule. Unique and to carry: the prior-art map (structural risk, gradual disempowerment, ARCHES, Gabriel) and the 'no game accelerated beyond the metabolic rate of its own rules' governance proposals. Not on the spine.

title: Keep the possibility space open (开, 护开不闭)
summary: 开 is a state, not a quantity. Closing comes from compounding axes, measures collapsing, correlated failure and disabled correction. AI raises the gain. The constructive side is a non-capturable abundance floor, exit, plurality and fast correction. 成闭 is distinguished from 护闭, and 伪开 is named. 'We will not close the world' is a minimal totalization. Three problems are open.
note: Restated on the spine: widening and narrowing, four cases of a part, closing needs a net draw, own widening (OW1), capture. Unique: 护闭 versus 成闭 versus 伪开 as distinctions, the 29-proposition proof sketch with its 56-criticism review, and the three open problems. The README is not valid UTF-8 in places (legacy bytes).

title: Intelligence must be good (智善)
summary: The totalizing attractor pulls selection rules themselves. It is measured by non-compensable loss of the capacity to sense, refuse, correct and exit. AI changes its clock speed. 'Do not fight for us.' The good is a direction: whatever continues 生生, with four conditions 生之通之纠之不闭之. Evil is owning the gate life must pass. AI as planetary technology, engineered exit, 善不姓国.
note: The direction of 生生 and the four conditions are restated as the continuation condition plus C and the good/evil boundaries. 'Owning the gate' corresponds to closing through net draw on what others require. Unique: planetary technology as a category, the exit-engineering list (commitment registries, symmetric verification, pause protocols), and the inward-cutting self-limits (dissolution clause).

title: 论纲: the strongest claims, with strength and status kept apart (纲·一–纲·九)
summary: Nine theses: what lasts shows joint uptake, plus a drain threshold; the state of a source under uptake (conjecture); selection through couplings lowering what it does not sense; a stated concern including the unnamed (AI, conjecture); widening as what every positive weighting shares (VD1 failed); warning signs only through coupling; capture outlasting its refutation. Then two theses with argument (one unfolding; good = 生生, read as widening) and four unifications (oversight, Pareto, Landauer, Zhuang–Hadfield-Menell). Each states what it excludes, what would refute it, and tests passed or failed.
source: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md 论纲 纲·一–纲·九
note: Mirrors the canonical chapter's 'theses and conjectures'; it is a classical edition of that section. The empirical tests (MQ1, MQ2, CG1, VD1) belong to that section.

title: Two premises named in classical form: 凡续皆有顾 (scope) and 以广为愈 (order)
summary: 凡续皆有顾 (the continuation condition) fixes whose losses count, and 不易乎畛 (the step of invariance) extends it to losses that return to no one. 以广为愈 (C) alone orders. Both are 设: stated, not asserted, and their warrant is open. The book never says the ethics derives from the condition.
source: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md 序 两个设, 篇十五, 篇十六; CIVILIZATION-THOUGHT-AND-BECOMING.md §五·四
note: Same as the canonical scope-and-order rule; carry only the naming.

title: Evolutionary explanation is not ethical validity
summary: The evolutionary explanation of a disposition, its ethical validity, its recognition and its actual preservation are different achievements. Living significance and further comparison principles stay visible commitments. Reproductive advantage cannot silently serve as ethical authority.
source: THE-THEORY-OF-EVOLUTION.md, Retained empirical continuation (line 144); Completion requirements row 6; line 24
note: Its older wording (living significance as a commitment) should be restated with the continuation condition plus C.

title: Alignment uses of the market results
summary: Check how pursuing an aim changes the correction margin and the future selection domain. Stronger executive power that erodes revision can widen the conditions under which degeneration is sustainable. Correction has timing requirements: who still has support during the transition. Attractiveness, efficiency, growth or resilience cannot replace comparison. Dynamics alone allocates no obligation.
source: MARKETS-AND-GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md, closing paragraphs of 'Degeneration boundaries', 'Local attraction', 'Supported finite transition', 'Partial correction'
note: Phrased via the 'conditional alignment route' and 'existing practical principles'. It needs restating with the continuation condition (scope) plus C (order).
